name: closed expiration windows include both endpoints
input: one grant queried before at and after its usable interval
test:
ledger = EventTimeCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('atlas', 8, 6, 14)
assert ledger.get_balance(5) is None
assert ledger.get_balance(6) == 8
assert ledger.get_balance(20) == 8
assert ledger.get_balance(21) is None

name: debits use earliest expiration before later grants
input: two active grants with different expiration times
test:
ledger = EventTimeCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('late', 6, 10, 35)
ledger.add_credit('early', 4, 20, 10)
ledger.debit(3, 20)
assert ledger.get_balance(20) == 7
assert ledger.get_balance(30) == 7
assert ledger.get_balance(31) == 6

name: replays by event time instead of submission order
input: a debit is recorded before an earlier-time grant
test:
ledger = EventTimeCreditLedger()
ledger.debit(5, 27)
ledger.add_credit('late-arrival', 5, 18, 20)
assert ledger.get_balance(17) is None
assert ledger.get_balance(18) == 5
assert ledger.get_balance(27) == 0

name: underfunding creates debt and later grants pay it before becoming credit
input: an insufficient debit followed by a later grant
test:
ledger = EventTimeCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('first', 7, 4, 16)
ledger.debit(30, 9)
assert ledger.get_balance(4) == 7
assert ledger.get_balance(9) is None
ledger.add_credit('settle', 30, 10, 20)
assert ledger.get_balance(10) == 7

name: duplicate labels still create distinct expiring pools
input: two grants with the same descriptive label
test:
ledger = EventTimeCreditLedger()
ledger.add_credit('shared', 9, 5, 30)
ledger.add_credit('shared', 9, 17, 30)
ledger.debit(13, 22)
assert ledger.get_balance(5) == 9
assert ledger.get_balance(17) == 18
assert ledger.get_balance(22) == 5
assert ledger.get_balance(40) == 5
